description.zh: SDK 示例插件：用自己的插件 token 读取 Ghost 的控制平面事件流，在自己的页面里显示最近 200 条。
description.en: The SDK example plugin: reads Ghost's control-plane event stream with its own plugin token and shows the latest 200 events in its own page.

description.zh: 开发者参考示例：官方参考插件，逐项演示 v1 插件能做的每一件事，并申请全部六个权限（含读取完整访问历史的 events.read.data）。
description.en: A developer reference example: the official reference plugin demonstrates every v1 plugin capability and requests all six permissions (including events.read.data, the full browsing history).
